preferredClass.label: Agentic web interoperability resolver
preferredClass.definition: Developer infrastructure that discovers heterogeneous machine- and agent-facing interfaces exposed by a website, preserves source authority and conflicts, normalizes the observations into an inspectable service map, and selects an interface for a concrete intent.

coreJobs: discover website machine and agent interfaces
normalize heterogeneous discovery evidence without replacing upstream protocols
route read, search, structured, tool and agent intents to suitable interfaces
audit search and agent-facing technical signals against dated primary-source rules
record runtime and visibility evidence separately from static declarations

notEquivalentTo.reason: ARWP intentionally does not collapse evidence into one readiness score.
ARWP can store owner-supplied visibility evidence, but prompt/mention/citation tracking is not its primary product.

notEquivalentTo.class: AI crawler control or WAF product
notEquivalentTo.reason: ARWP observes and audits crawler policy; it does not enforce network access rules.
MCP is one upstream interface ARWP can discover and verify; ARWP is not the MCP protocol itself.
A2A Agent Cards and callable interfaces are upstream evidence resolved by ARWP.
WebMCP is a browser runtime surface ARWP can observe or evaluate when runtime evidence is available.
ARWP audits technical eligibility and evidence but does not promise or measure organic rank as its core output.

closestAdjacentClasses.overlap: multi-layer agent readiness, discovery surfaces, conformance checks, directory/discovery
closestAdjacentClasses.difference: AgentReady names readiness requirements and Ora provides scored scans and agent journeys; ARWP centers on interoperability resolution, provenance/conflict preservation and intent routing without a universal readiness score.

closestAdjacentClasses.overlap: robots, sitemap, parsing, protocol and API readiness checks
closestAdjacentClasses.difference: ARWP adds normalized multi-source service maps, source-authority/conflict handling, resolver planning and evidence history.
WebMCP is one runtime surface in ARWP's broader interoperability model rather than the product boundary.

closestAdjacentClasses.overlap: AI crawler visibility and policy awareness
closestAdjacentClasses.difference: Cloudflare monitors and enforces crawler access at the network edge; ARWP audits policy and interoperability but does not enforce traffic rules.

closestAdjacentClasses.overlap: AI citation/visibility evidence and competitor context
closestAdjacentClasses.difference: These products primarily track mentions, citations, prompts, sentiment or share of voice; ARWP primarily resolves and verifies website interfaces and can ingest such measurements as external evidence.
